description: Track changes (Type > Track Changes, Track Changes panel): turn tracking on or off for a story or every story, list tracked changes with type, author and date, accept or reject one change, all changes in a story or document, or only those by one user, and go to the next, previous, first or last change

action.description: enable | disable | list | accept | reject | select (go to a change)

indexes.description: accept/reject/select: change indexes within the story, as list reports them (needs story)

story.description: Which story: frameId (any text frame of the story), storyId (from get_document_stories), or selection: true (the story of the selected text or text frame)

frameId.description: Id of a text frame in the story

selection.description: Use the story of the current selection

userName.description: accept/reject: only changes by this user (Accept/Reject All Changes by This User)

which.description: select: the change after or before the selection, or the first or last change of the story

name: manage_tracked_changes
title: Manage Tracked Changes
